title: ia format checks staleness once per run
summary: ia format now drafts every file against one session and makes its staleness check (a full refresh of the workspace) once, after the last file and before any write, instead of after every file. A run that drafts nothing still makes no check. On a 4,700-record tree, format --check took 1,463 s and now takes 822 s, with an identical envelope. formatSource takes an opt-in defer, and the new recheckFormat makes the deferred check; single-file callers keep the per-call check. The once-per-run check also re-reads every drafted file, so it refuses a file changed after its draft, which the per-file check could miss.
